properties.disease overview: A benign cystic bone lesion (often in children/adolescents) presenting as a radiolucent intramedullary cavity; may be asymptomatic until a pathological fracture occurs.
properties.mechanism: Benign fluid-filled cavity within bone leading to thinning of cortex and weakening of structural integrity; predisposes to pathological fracture; treated with curettage and bone grafting in selected cases.
